description: Prompt for classifying a block or a health check's problem as a harness, project or environment issue, with its reasoning (ASS-107): where its fix is made

input-arguments.name: problem
input-arguments.description: The checked analysis of the problem: summary, root cause, evidence
input-arguments.example: Dev container needs rebuilding: node 24 image changed

issue.description: Where the fix is made: harness (a fix ticket in the harness project's backlog), project (one in the project's own ticket system; the harness's backlog on the harness project), environment (where the work runs: repaired in place, else by the operator)

human-action.description: Environment only: what the operator must do should it not be repaired in place; left out otherwise
